commands:
MNWLOGIN=`perl -e '$s=shift;$s=~s/([\W])/"%".uc(sprintf("%2.2x",ord($1)))/eg;print $s' ''`
MNWPASS=`perl -e '$s=shift;$s=~s/([\W])/"%".uc(sprintf("%2.2x",ord($1)))/eg;print $s' ''`
PROTOCOL=`awk '{IGNORECASE=1;if($1=="tcp"){print $2;exit}}' /etc/protocols`
if [ -z "$PROTOCOL" ]; then PROTOCOL=tcp; fi
DATETIME=`perl -e '@t=gmtime(<time>);printf "%4d-%02d-%02d+%02d:%02d:%02d",1900+$t[5],$t[4]+1,$t[3],$t[2],$t[1],$t[0]'`
wget --no-verbose --tries=3 --waitretry=10 --connect-timeout=10 --read-timeout=60 --retry-connrefused --output-document=- --user-agent=Fail2ban "http://mynetwatchman.com/insertwebreport.asp?AT=2&AV=0&AgentEmail=$MNWLOGIN&AgentPassword=$MNWPASS&AttackerIP=<ip>&SrcPort=0&ProtocolID=$PROTOCOL&DestPort=0&AttackCount=<failures>&VictimIP=`ip -4 addr show dev eth0 | grep inet | head -n 1 | sed -r 's/.*inet ([0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}).*/\1/'`&AttackDateTime=$DATETIME" 2>&1 >> /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-mynetwatchman.out && grep -q 'Attack Report Insert Successful' /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-mynetwatchman.out && rm -f /var/run/fail2ban/tmp-mynetwatchman.out
